title: Special Executive Programme In Global Finance And Strategy
description: The course aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of global finance and strategic decision-making in the context of globalization.
longDescription: This course covers the complexities of globalization, its impact on businesses, and the financial strategies needed to navigate the global market. Students will learn how to assess investment opportunities, manage global risks, and construct strategies that enhance organizational value.
courseDetails: Focusing on the intersection of finance and strategy, this course equips students with the skills to evaluate strategic decisions, manage global risks, and assess investment opportunities in multinational environments. Students will also explore sources of finance, the impact of global business environments on organizations, and strategies that drive value creation. modules.title: Global Finance And Strategy
modules.summary: The Global Finance and Strategy course delves into how globalization shapes the business landscape and how financial strategies can support organizational success. Students will develop the ability to analyze financial consequences, assess global risks, and make informed investment decisions. The course integrates practical tools and theoretical insights to help businesses thrive in a globalized world.

lessons.title: Developing Strategies to Enhance Organisational Value
Understanding the Role of Strategic Decisions and their Financial Impact
Understanding Sources of Finance & Techniques to Manage Global Risk
Understanding Potential Investment Decisions & Global Strategies

outcomes: Understand the impact of the global business environment on national and multinational business organisations.
Be able to construct strategies that will result in the enhancement of organisational value.
Be able to evaluate the financial consequences of strategic decisions.
Be able to assess techniques to manage global risk.
Be able to assess potential investment decisions and global strategies.
